description: HENRICO, VA – A new Washington Post-Schar School poll released today shows Shannon Taylor leading Rep. Rob Wittman 50% to 46% in Virginia's 1st Congressional District. The poll comes one day after Sabato's Crystal Ball moved the race from Leans Republican to toss-up, and as the Taylor campaign announces a major $2 million Q3 fundraising haul.
